news.headline: Surprise! Three Baby Capybaras Arrive at Once
news.body: Zookeepers at Edinburgh Zoo in Scotland got a happy surprise this week. Three capybara pups were born overnight to their parents, Luna and Rodney! The triplets are doing well and are staying close to their mom for now. In a few weeks, the pups will get their first checkup, and then keepers will find out if they are boys or girls and pick their names. Capybaras are the biggest rodents in the whole world.

news.headline: Faraway Voyager 1 Finds a Way to Save Energy
news.body: Voyager 1 blasted off way back in 1977, and now it is about 16 billion miles from Earth, out in the space between the stars. Its power slowly runs lower every year, so NASA engineers swapped three of its parts for ones that use less energy. That means its science tools can keep working longer. The spacecraft also went quiet for two days this month, but then it started talking to Earth again all by itself!

news.headline: A 6-Year-Old Becomes the World's Youngest DJ
news.body: Illumi Maeda from Japan started learning to be a DJ when she was only 3 years old. Now, at 6, she holds a Guinness World Records title as the youngest girl ever to DJ at a club! She played music for more than an hour in front of a big, cheering crowd. She felt nervous, but she kept going. Someday she wants to play music at festivals around the world and open an ice cream shop where she can DJ too.
